address_domains: PCs are debug FWSEC Falcon IMEM VAs; scratch/PRI keys are synthetic GPU register operands. I[0xb00] is Falcon IO; output/stack words are synthetic Falcon data space.
limits: No full loader execution, installed-byte identity, production equivalence or actual error attribution. Opaque loader results are explicit continuation fixtures. Selector 1 chooses raw-aa mode and the core HALTED wait; the raw-bc timed poll is an alternate branch. Timer threshold is raw 0x8000000 with unknown time unit/rate. Neither a stalled timer nor an unset HALTED bit is converted into an invented hardware timeout.
